how: A fresh session loads the skill with the client context below as the whole client file, runs the checklist on each asset, and returns the verdict and the failed check names. Compare with expected. Record the run in runs.md.

client_context.register: BG ти on social, Вие in booking messages

fact_sheet.allergen_policy: ask the kitchen; no written allergen matrix yet

client_context.character_sheet: Nia: dark hair tied back, the brand's green apron, anchor detail a brass pin; settings: the real room and the street

cases.asset: Instagram caption (BG+EN): 'Last chance! The autumn menu ends Sunday. Book now before it's gone.' Fact sheet: winter menu from 14 Nov (true).
cases.note: True fact, pressure wording: rewrite as the plain fact once.

cases.asset: Story text: 'Only 2 tables left tonight!' No reservation count exists; walk-in venue.
Reel script with Nia (AI persona) speaking from 0.0 s; cue sheet has no on-screen label; caption has no #AIcreated; platform label toggle not mentioned.
cases.note: Face & voice is 'unverified on final cut' as well (script only), but the block decides.

cases.asset: Drafted reply to a Google review: 'So sorry you felt unwell after the mussels; our kitchen takes allergies seriously, please DM us.'
cases.note: Illness and allergy are guardrails 11 topics: facts to the approver, no draft.

cases.asset: Instagram caption: 'Тази вечер на ул. Шипка: зимното меню, от 14 ноември. Масата за четирима е свободна в 19:00.' / 'Tonight on Shipka street: the winter menu, from 14 November. The table for four is free at seven.' Photo of a real guest with staff-release Petar in frame. One CTA: 'Book'.
cases.note: Facts match the fact sheet, locality named, one CTA, consent on file.

cases.asset: Persona video script with full cue sheet, label from frame 1, #AIcreated in caption, platform toggle noted; no stills, no cut yet.
cases.note: Nothing blocks; the face check is unverified until stills or the cut exist.

cases.asset: Persona still for a feed post: Nia with a different hairstyle and a red jacket; the character sheet locks dark hair tied back and the brand's green apron; setting is the real room.
cases.note: Face, wardrobe, anchor detail and setting must match the character sheet; a mismatch is regenerated, not fixed in copy.

cases.asset: Google Business post: 'Open every day from 17:00, winter menu from 10 November.' Fact sheet: Tue-Sun 18:00-24:00, winter menu from 14 Nov.
cases.note: Two facts contradict the fact sheet; a fact error in a public post is block-level.

cases.asset: Instagram story: repost of a guest's photo of the room with the guest's face visible, caption 'Thank you for this one'. consents/ holds only the staff release for Petar; no UGC permission for this guest.
cases.note: UGC needs written permission in consents/ (guardrails 2 and 7).

cases.asset: TikTok clip delivered as a 16:9 landscape file, 95 seconds, caption with 14 hashtags and the hook card inside the bottom safe zone; copy itself is clean and on-brand.
cases.note: Ratio, length, hashtag count and safe zones are fix-level; the corrected spec is supplied.

cases.asset: Persona feed post, label from frame 1, #AIcreated in caption, platform label noted, facts match the sheet; one correction for Nia is still open from last week.
cases.note: An open correction holds persona content until the approver closes it (guardrails 6 error rule); nothing blocks.

cases.asset: Instagram caption: 'We are the best kitchen on Shipka street and we know it. Come and see what we can do.' Anchor named: 'The table is the centre'. Hours and street match the fact sheet; no pressure device.
cases.note: The brand is the hero and the copy contradicts the plain / not hyped pair; the named anchor is not reinforced. Rewrite with the guest as hero around the table.
